masterResume.summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating scalable multi-tenant backend systems. Strong background in data structures and algorithms, system design, distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, performance optimization, security, and reliability. Experienced in technical leadership, code reviews, debugging, and delivering systems under latency, scalability, cost, and security constraints.

experience.company: Deloitte USI — Prism Portfolio (HealthPrism, PeoplePrism, Project Omega)
bullets: Designed and optimized backend services for multi-tenant analytics platforms, improving scalability, performance, and reliability across production workloads with increasing concurrency.

Developed and optimized an LLM-powered natural-language-to-SQL analytics system by improving session management and enabling greater parallel tool execution, achieving approximately 40% faster p50 response times.
Designed and implemented a RAG-based metadata query sub-agent using Vertex AI RAG Engine, integrating retrieval capabilities into existing backend workflows.
Reduced p95 API latency by 30% and lowered Snowflake compute costs by designing and implementing centralized Redis caching with TTL-based and event-driven cache invalidation.

Re-architected backend service initialization and resource management, achieving approximately 3× faster startup times and enabling lower minimum replicas under autoscaling, reducing infrastructure costs by $20K+ annually.
Led Snowflake performance and cost optimization using materialized views, workload-specific warehouses, and Streams/Tasks, reducing overall compute expenditure by approximately 20%.
Designed and enforced fine-grained RBAC across multi-tenant services and implemented asynchronous audit pipelines, preventing cross-tenant access risks without impacting request latency.
Owned production deployments, debugging, and incident resolution, diagnosing regression and scaling issues as system concurrency increased approximately 3× and driving fixes through deployment.
Primary code reviewer for Prism backend services, ensuring quality, efficiency, and maintainability.
Collaborated with MLOps and Data Science teams to develop automated quality-control pipelines against ground truth, reducing data release timelines by approximately 50%.

Led technical knowledge-sharing initiatives, facilitating team-wide design and engineering sessions and a 3-month internal App Chapter series covering system design trade-offs, design patterns, scalability, and production engineering.
